name: Conventions board renders seeded candidates, evidence and the scan summary
description: Loads /conventions and confirms the seeded acme/payments-api board renders: an accepted model-proposed rule, a rejected one (still visible, just deprioritized), a zero-cost config-derived rule, the scan summary counters, and the Create-skill action once accepted candidates exist. Read-only seeded data (no scan click — a real extraction is a paid LLM call and would break determinism). Interactive triage (accept/reject/edit/filter clicks) is covered instead by client unit tests (ConventionCard.test.tsx, helpers.test.ts). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Always use async/await instead of .then() chains.

a seeded config-derived rule renders (origin: config)
